checkResults.actualResult: 12 tests pass. Diagnosed and closed gap: the DSH backend emits precise operational refusals (CHECKLIST_INCOMPLETE, EVIDENCE_REQUIRED, OPEN_ESCALATION, VISIT_ALREADY_COMPLETE, VISIT_ALREADY_IN_PROGRESS, LOCATION_REQUIRED, LOCATION_STALE, LOCATION_ACCURACY, LOCATION_MOCKED, GEOFENCE_VIOLATION) and the shared classifier resolved them, but zero of twenty-six app-field files and zero control-panel readers consumed problem.code, problem.nextAction, or problem.retryable. Every consumer of the field-readiness controllers now renders through the governed view model: six app-field screens and the control-panel field-readiness queue.
checkResults.proves: The reason code, the allowed next action, the retry semantics, and the support correlation id survive from the backend response to the shared view model consumed by app-field and control-panel.
checkResults.doesNotProve: It does not prove the rendered pixels, the operator readback against a live backend, or convergence with app-partner, app-client, and app-captain.

checkResults.actualResult: PASS. Two message-text dependencies were found and removed. DshFieldSurface decided recover-versus-retry by matching the substring 'field offline queue is corrupt' against the error message; the queue now throws FieldOfflineQueueCorruptError carrying code OFFLINE_QUEUE_CORRUPT and the surface branches on that code. DshFieldVisitScreen detected a queued start-visit operation by matching the Arabic substring 'بدء الزيارة'; the queued state now carries operationType and the screen compares against create_visit. The guard forbids .message.includes/startsWith/endsWith/match inside the field roots so neither pattern can return.
checkResults.proves: Offline recovery and queued-operation identification are driven by stable codes rather than localized copy, so rewording or translating a message cannot change behavior.
checkResults.doesNotProve: It does not prove real queue corruption recovery, reconnect replay, duplicate suppression, or evidence retention on a device.

checkResults.actualResult: Exit 0. captureGovernedLocation in DshFieldVisitScreen threw bare Error objects with hardcoded prose for permission denial, mocked location, invalid fix, and poor accuracy, bypassing the taxonomy entirely so client-detected location refusals read differently from identical server refusals. It now resolves canonical definitions through the shared classifier and emits LOCATION_SERVICES_DISABLED, LOCATION_PERMISSION_DENIED, LOCATION_MOCKED, LOCATION_REQUIRED, and LOCATION_ACCURACY. A device-services check was added ahead of the permission prompt. Media evidence failures likewise emit MEDIA_PERMISSION_DENIED and MEDIA_UPLOAD_FAILED instead of raw strings.
checkResults.proves: A locally detected location or media refusal carries the same code, next action, and retry semantics as the equivalent server refusal.
checkResults.doesNotProve: It does not prove real GPS accuracy handling, mock-location detection, geofence enforcement, or camera and permission behavior on a device.
